identity.name: Compromised Process Accessing Rare Cloud Resource via PowerShell
identity.summary: A compromised Windows process executes PowerShell commands to access a rare cloud resource, triggering an ABIOC alert for unusual cloud activity. Cortex should detect the process behavior and network
identity.description: A compromised Windows process executes PowerShell commands to access a rare cloud resource, triggering an ABIOC alert for unusual cloud activity. Cortex should detect the process behavior and network connection to a test cloud endpoint.

execution.framework_reference_id: T1003.001 — Atomic Test #1 (Dump LSASS.exe Memory using ProcDump) / Atomic Test #3 (Dump LSASS using comsvcs.dll)

prerequisites.description: Local administrator rights on the target Windows endpoint.
Cortex XDR agent installed and reporting healthy.

iocs.context: Generic Windows malware family — CortexSim does not execute it

biocs.name: Compromised Process Accessing Rare Cloud Resource
biocs.description: A compromised process accesses a rare cloud resource via HTTP GET request
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'

xql_queries.name: Detect Compromised Process Accessing Rare Cloud Resource
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, action_remote_ip

analytics_modules: Cortex XSIAM Analytics (XDR Agent) — A compromised process accessed a rare cloud resource; Required Data: XDR Agent. Ref: https://cortex-docs.paloaltonetworks.com/analytics-alerts/alerts-by-name/a-compromised-process-accessed-a-rare-cloud-resource

abiocs.name: Unusual Cloud Access by Compromised Process
abiocs.description: A compromised process accesses a rare cloud endpoint that is not typically accessed by normal processes
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'

products.evidence_query: Playbook: Credential Theft Response — isolate host, force domain-wide password reset for impacted accounts, ticket DFIR.
WildFire verdict on any dropped Mimikatz binary downstream of the dump.

threat_scenarios.name: Ransomware Kill-Chain Disruption — Credential Theft Stage
threat_scenarios.description: Block or detect LSASS credential dumping, the pivot stage of nearly every ransomware kill chain (BlackSuit Blitz, DragonForce, etc.).

threat_steps.objective: Cortex XDR Credential Theft Protection blocks the comsvcs.dll MiniDump attempt before the dump file is fully written.
preconditions: Cortex XDR agent >= 8.4.0 installed on target.
Profile includes Credential Theft Protection enabled in Block mode.
steps: Confirm rundll32 process is terminated and dump file is absent or zero-byte.
success_criteria: Process terminated within 5s; XDR alert `BTP-CRED-LSASS-001` raised with severity High.
Dump file size = 0 bytes or absent.
End-user notified via agent toast (if enabled).

threat_steps.objective: If prevention is in Report-Only mode, BIOC + correlation rule still fire as detection.
success_criteria: BIOC `LSASS Handle Open With Sensitive Access Rights` fires within 30s.
Cortex XDR Endpoint Isolation applied to host within 90s.
Investigation ticket created in SOAR + ITSM.

preventive_controls: Enable Cortex XDR Credential Theft Protection in Block mode for all production endpoints.
Enable LSA Protection (RunAsPPL) on supported Windows builds.
Restrict local administrator membership; implement LAPS for the local admin password.
detection_engineering: Tune BIOC allowlist for legitimate processes that access LSASS (AV, EDR, backup agents) — alert on everything else.
Build hunts for comsvcs.dll MiniDump, rundll32.exe with unusual exports, and Sysmon Event ID 10 with GrantedAccess 0x1010 or 0x1410.
Correlate LSASS access events with downstream Mimikatz indicators (kerberos ticket extraction, DC sync calls).
